why: A revised quote replying on top of the earlier (higher) quote. Whatever parses this must read the NEW message, not the quoted chain — the regex fallback picks the largest figure anywhere in the text, so the quoted $52,000 wins unless the chain is stripped first.
text:

Grand total: $47,500.00 delivered
Lead time: 2 weeks

Sam
